title: peak.yaml
description: What a repo is, what owns what, and what to read first, for people and coding agents. Spec: https://github.com/bergaaberg/peak/blob/main/SPEC.md

version.description: The format version. Leave it out or write 1.

name.description: The project's name, as people say it.

description.description: One sentence on what it is.

url.description: Where it runs or is published.

tier.description: How much care the repo gets. active: worked on now, changes go through review and CI. maintained: kept working, changes are small and careful. scratch: experiments, anything goes. Other words are allowed. Default: active.

owner.description: Who answers for it: a forge handle, @user or @org/team.

provider.description: Where the runs entries run unless they say otherwise, e.g. cloudflare. Tools may assume one when it is left out.

components.description: The parts of the repo, each with the paths it owns.

owns.description: Paths or globs, relative to the repo root (e.g. src/web/, packages/db/**).

rules.description: A repo-relative file with the rules for working in this component.

owner.description: Who answers for this component, when not the repo’s owner: @user or @org/team.

docs.description: What to read first: label → repo-relative path (e.g. architecture: ARCHITECTURE.md).

health.description: What a dashboard should watch beyond runs. health.workers is read as production workers too; new files should name them under runs.

workers.description: Names of deployed services (e.g. Cloudflare Workers).

runs.description: What the repo deploys, in production.

uses.description: What the repo depends on: another repo’s peak (owner/name) or an outside service (a word).

what.description: Which of that repo’s runs entries, when not all of it.

environments.description: Environments other than production, by name: only what differs. A kind named under runs replaces production’s list of that kind.

url.description: Where it runs or is published.

runs.description: What is deployed, by kind. Each entry is a name, or a mapping with name and more.

anyOf.description: The name its provider knows it by. Ending in * it is a pattern: every one with that prefix not named before it in the list.

name.description: The name its provider knows it by. Ending in * it is a pattern: every one with that prefix not named before it in the list.

provider.description: Where it runs, when not the file’s provider.

component.description: The component it belongs to (a components name).

hosts.description: For a worker that only serves static files: the hostnames it serves.

objects.description: The Durable Object classes this worker holds.
